# Candor UI components

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-agents.mjs from src/docs/api.json; edit the components' doc comments, not this file. -->

324 items. Install any of them with `npx candor-ui add <name>` after `npx candor-ui init`; free items need no licence key. Files land in folders of their own: `@/components/candor/…`, `@/components/candor/ui/…` and `@/lib/candor/…`.

## Chat

A conversation with an agent: messages, the composer, tool calls, reasoning, citations.

- **a2ui-surface** (Pro): Draws an A2UI surface with Candor's parts, streaming or finished, with inputs bound to its data model. Exports `A2uiSurface`, `parsePointer`, `joinPath`, `getAtPath`, `setAtPath`, `emptyA2uiState`, `applyA2uiMessage`, `applyA2uiMessages`, `setA2uiData`, `createA2uiStore`, `resolveA2uiValue`, `createA2uiCard`.
- **agent-avatar** (free): An agent's glyph and hue by role, so people can tell agents apart at a glance. Exports `AgentAvatar`, `AgentBadge`, `AgentRolesProvider`, `useAgentRoles`.
- **ai-content-label** (Pro): A label for content that is wholly or partly AI-generated: "AI-generated", "AI-modified", or "AI involvement not recorded" when the app has no record. Exports `AiContentLabel`, `provenanceText`, `withProvenance`, `provenanceMetadata`, `useCopyWithProvenance`.
- **ai-disclosure** (free): A plain notice that the person is interacting with an AI system: a first line in the thread (`variant="line"`) or a compact "AI" badge for a thread header (`variant="badge"`) that opens to the app's own explanation. Exports `AiDisclosure`.
- **attachment-preview** (free): Attached files: a chip in the composer for a file waiting to be sent (name, upload progress or error, size, remove) and tiles for sent files, with an image preview when the app supplies one. Exports `AttachmentChip`, `AttachmentPreview`, `AttachmentList`, `formatFileSize`, `fileIcon`.
- **candor-provider** (Pro): Candor's app-wide settings in one place: the interface's language, the app's nouns, its entity kinds and agent roles, its cards and the tooltip timing, so an app wraps once instead of nesting six providers. Exports `CandorProvider`.
- **card-registry** (free): The cards an agent's reply can carry, each with a check on its props; a card from a model renders only when its props pass. Exports `RegistryCard`, `CardRegistryProvider`, `isObject`, `isArrayOf`, `isString`, `defineCard`.
- **citation** (free): An inline [n] that opens its source in a popover, so evidence is one step away without leaving the thread. Exports `Citation`, `SourceList`, `SourceDetail`.
- **composer** (free): Where a person writes to the agent: @ mentions attach things as references, / starts a known action, and the scope says where the ask runs. Exports `Composer`.
- **context-meter** (free): What fills the model's context budget, as a ring in the composer that opens to a breakdown: system, instructions, Know, the thread, tools, files. Exports `ContextMeter`.
- **copilot-panel** (Pro): An embeddable copilot for an existing product: a launcher button with the app's unread count, and a panel with the conversation, built from the free chat items (Thread, Message, Composer, AiDisclosure, PromptSuggestions). Exports `CopilotPanel`.
- **dictation** (Pro): Voice input for the composer: a microphone button that dictates speech to text into the message box, on the device or through your own transcribe, for the person to edit before sending. Exports `DictationButton`, `useDictation`.
- **entity-chip** (free): A thing in the user's system (a table, a record, a flow) as a chip with its kind's icon, that can open it. Exports `EntityChip`, `EntityKindsProvider`, `useEntityKinds`.
- **entity-disambiguation** (Pro): When a name matches more than one thing ("Account" the table, the report, the record type), the agent asks which one instead of guessing. Exports `EntityDisambiguation`.
- **folded-turns** (free): A run of turns folded into one line, for long agent work a reader doesn't need to see step by step: "Drafted three versions and compared them". Exports `FoldedTurns`.
- **mcp-app-frame** (Pro): Shows an MCP App, a tool's own UI, isolated in a sandbox on another origin; without a sandbox it says why instead of running it. - **message-actions** (free): Copy, retry and rate under an agent's reply. Exports `MessageActions`.
- **message-branches** (Pro): Page through versions of a reply (after a retry or an edited question): "‹ 2 / 3 ›". Exports `MessageBranches`.
- **message-content** (free): A message's typed blocks (paragraphs, lists, code, tool calls, cards), rendered as text, never as markdown or HTML. Exports `MessageContent`, `Inline`, `blocksToText`.

- **model-picker** (Pro): Which model the next message uses, as a small menu for Composer's `tools` slot. Exports `ModelPicker`.
- **payload** (free): A block of code or query text from the agent: a query it ran, code it wrote, a config file. Exports `Payload`.
- **permission-prompt** (free): A tool call an agent asks to make, waiting for a person to approve or deny it before it runs: what it will do, why it reached them, and the permission mode the run is in. Exports `PermissionPrompt`.
- **prompt-suggestions** (free): Prompts to start from. Exports `PromptSuggestions`.
- **reasoning** (free): The agent's stated reasoning above its answer. Exports `Reasoning`.
- **report-reply** (Pro): Flag a reply for a person to review: why, and an optional note. Exports `ReportReply`.
- **search-trace** (Pro): A search an agent ran, as a tool-call row: what it did in plain words, its status and how long it took, and a count of the searches and the sources read. Exports `SearchTrace`, `sourceDomain`.
- **selection-actions** (Pro): Select text inside a reply and act on just that part: ask a follow-up about it, have it explained, or quote it into the composer. Exports `SelectionActions`.
- **standard-cards** (Pro): The cards Candor ships, ready to register: query results, metrics, a plan (with its state: proposed, accepted or sent back), a blast radius and test results.
- **thread-divider** (free): A rule across the thread with a label in the middle: a day ("Today", "Yesterday", "5 Nov 2026") or a chapter of the conversation ("Drafting", "Review"). Exports `ThreadDivider`.
- **thread-event** (free): A quiet, centred line in a thread for something that happened rather than something said: "Sam joined", "Switched to the staging environment", "Run stopped by a guardrail". Exports `ThreadEvent`.
- **thread-header** (Pro): The bar above a thread: its title, the environment it acts on, and who is working on it right now. Exports `ThreadHeader`.
- **thread** (free): The scrolling message column. Exports `Thread`.
- **tool-call** (free): One tool call as a compact row: what it did in plain words, its status, and how long it took. Exports `ToolCall`, `ToolCallGroup`.

## Agent work

What an agent proposes and does: plans, approvals, diffs, runs, receipts.

- **agent-activity** (Pro): Who is working right now: each agent, what it is doing in plain words, and its state in words beside the dot, so state is never colour alone. Exports `AgentActivity`.
- **agent-screen** (Pro): A live view of a computer-use or browser agent's screen, from frames or a stream the app passes. Exports `AgentScreen`.
- **approval-queue** (Pro): Approval requests by what they need from the viewer. Exports `ApprovalQueue`.
- **approval-request** (Pro): A request for second-level approval: what changes, where, what it touches, whether it can be undone, and the hash that ties the decision to exactly this change. Compact for a phone or a notification. Exports `ApprovalRequest`, `ApprovalDecision`.
- **blast-radius** (Pro): What a plan step can reach in the environment, grouped by kind of thing. Exports `BlastRadius`.
- **change-diff** (Pro): The change as files: one tab per file, each named by the thing it is (a field, a layout) as well as its path, with a unified diff that highlights the exact words that changed inside a line. Exports `ChangeDiff`.
- **change-set-review** (Pro): Many record edits an agent proposes, for a person to keep or drop one by one. Exports `ChangeSetReview`.
- **checkpoint-list** (Pro): Restore points in a run, one per turn, with what each one holds and where the person is now. Exports `CheckpointList`.
- **clarifying-questions** (Pro): The agent's questions before it plans (the first of two turns). Exports `ClarifyingQuestions`.
- **code-editor** (Pro): A small editor for code or a query a person writes or corrects: line numbers, the same token colours as CodeListing and Payload drawn under the text, Tab and Shift+Tab to indent, and a validation message from your app tied to its line and read out with the field (`aria-describedby`). Exports `CodeEditor`, `indentEdit`.
- **code-listing** (Pro): Code to read, with line numbers: a file the agent wrote, the lines a finding points at, a config before it changes. Exports `CodeListing`, `codeLanguageLabel`, `codeLines`, `codeLineNodes`.
- **compare-slider** (Pro): Two versions of the same thing side by side, with a divider the person drags to see more of one or the other: what a checkpoint restore would put back against what is there now, a prose rewrite against the original, a dashboard before and after a change. Exports `CompareSlider`.
- **document-progress-queue** (Pro): Per-document progress for a batch an agent works through: each document queued, working (with the stage it's at, and a bar only when the pipeline measured how far that stage is), done (with what it came to), or failed (with the reason, and Retry). Exports `DocumentProgressQueue`.
- **document-viewer** (Pro): A document's pages, which the app renders, with labelled regions over them. Exports `DocumentViewer`.
- **environment-promotion** (Pro): Promote a configuration from one environment to another: where from and where to, in each environment's own colour, the diff of what changes, who has approved it and when, and what can and can't be rolled back. Exports `EnvironmentPromotion`.
- **extraction-review** (Pro): The fields an agent extracted from a document, beside its pages, for a person to accept or correct. Exports `ExtractionReview`.
- **file-list** (Pro): The files the work produced: each with its type, size and where it stands ("Checked", "Not yet checked"), Open for the ones the reader can show, and Download, with a menu when it comes in several formats. Exports `FileList`.
- **guardrail-notice** (Pro): One line saying a guardrail stopped something: what was stopped, and which rule stopped it. Exports `GuardrailNotice`.
- **hold-to-confirm** (Pro): A button a person holds down before a risky step runs: the pointer, or Space or Enter, kept down for `holdMs` (1.2 seconds unless the app says otherwise). Exports `HoldToConfirm`.
- **inline-suggestion** (Pro): An agent's proposed value beside a normal field: the field keeps its own value, and the suggestion sits under it, labelled as AI-generated, with Accept, Edit and Reject. Exports `InlineSuggestion`.
- **log-stream** (Pro): A run's live log. Exports `LogStream`, `ansiRuns`.
- **plan** (Pro): An agent's plan as steps the person shapes before it runs and follows while it does. Exports `Plan`.
- **proposal** (Pro): One action an agent proposes, with the alternatives it weighed beside it. Exports `Proposal`.
- **restore-dialog** (Pro): Restores a checkpoint's code, conversation or both, says what a restore doesn't undo, and shows what the app checked afterwards, never "Restored" without a check. Exports `RestoreDialog`, `RestoreResult`.
- **result-card** (Pro): A finished piece of work, handed over: the answer first, in a few lines, then the receipt (what it cost, how long it took, what checked it) and the files to open or download, then your actions (Accept, Ask for changes). Exports `ResultCard`.
- **result-table** (Pro): Query rows as a typed, sortable table. Exports `ResultTable`.
- **review-canvas** (Pro): The review surface for a run: the plan on one side; select a step and its log, diff, blast radius and reasoning appear on the other. Exports `ReviewCanvas`.
- **review-ladder** (Pro): How much a person reviews before agents act: the ladder from Advise to Full delegation. Exports `ReviewLadder`.
- **run-heartbeat** (Pro): A run's state that never claims it's alive when nothing has been heard: "No update since 10:42" past a threshold, a host that's offline, or what it needs from the person. Exports `RunHeartbeat`, `useLivenessWords`.
- **run-recovery** (Pro): The way on from a run that stopped: the steps up to where it broke, what went wrong at that step, and how to carry on: retry from the broken step (earlier work is kept), skip it and go on (when the app allows that), or stop. Exports `RunRecovery`.
- **run-tree** (Pro): Who is doing what: the orchestrator and the specialists it handed work to, as a tree. Exports `RunTree`.
- **ship-review** (Pro): The last look before a change reaches production: what ships, each check it must pass (validation, tests, approval), and how to undo it. Exports `ShipReview`.
- **steer-composer** (Pro): Send a message into a run while it works, and see whether the agent has picked it up yet, never shown as read until the service says so. Exports `SteerComposer`.
- **task-tray** (Pro): Work running in the background, as one pill: how many are running and how many need you. Exports `TaskTray`.
- **test-results** (Pro): A test run that leads with what failed. Exports `TestResults`.
- **undo-window** (Pro): An action just taken ("Deleted 3 rows"), with Undo for as long as the app says it can be undone: `until` (when the server said the window closes) or `seconds` (the window the server granted, counted from when this appears). Exports `UndoWindow`.
- **workflow-editor** (Pro): A workflow an agent proposes and a person edits before it runs: a trigger (an event in your app, a schedule, or a person starting it) and a list of steps and If/Else conditions. Exports `WorkflowEditor`.

## Adapters

Map an agent SDK's messages onto Candor's data: the Vercel AI SDK, the Claude Agent SDK and AG-UI.

- **ag-ui** (free): Turns AG-UI events into Candor messages, waiting approvals and usage, with AG-UI 1.0's shared state and activities. Exports `fromAgUiEvents`, `applyJsonPatch`.
- **ai-sdk** (free): Vercel AI SDK (v7) UI messages to Candor messages: text, reasoning, tool calls, sources and data cards. Exports `fromAiSdkMessages`, `fromAiSdkMessage`.
- **claude-agent-sdk** (free): Turns Claude Agent SDK events into Candor messages, waiting approvals (and the agent's questions), usage and sources, and a person's answer back into the SDK's result. Exports `fromClaudeAgentEvents`, `claudeQuestions`, `claudePermissionResult`, `claudeSuggestions`.
- **claude-agent-server** (free): The server half of the Claude Agent SDK adapter: stream a run to useClaudeAgent, keep its permission requests in a store your own route can answer, and let a browser re-attach to a run after a reload. Exports `memoryApprovalStore`, `waitByPolling`, `claudeCanUseTool`, `memoryRunStore`, `streamClaudeAgent`, `attachClaudeAgentRun`, `stopClaudeAgentRun`, `setClaudeAgentPermissionMode`, `answerClaudeApproval`, `answerClaudeAgentApproval`.
- **use-ag-ui** (free): Wires an AG-UI agent to Candor: messages for <Thread>/<Message>, props for <Composer>, and the interrupts waiting on a person. Exports `useAgUi`.
- **use-candor-chat** (free): Wires a `useChat()` result to Candor: messages for <Thread>/<Message>, props for <Composer>, and the tool calls waiting on a person. Exports `useCandorChat`.
- **use-claude-agent** (free): Wires a Claude Agent SDK server route to Candor: messages for <Thread>/<Message>, props for <Composer>, and the tool calls waiting on a person, re-attaching to a run after a reload. Exports `useClaudeAgent`.

## Agents

Who the agents are: rosters, profiles, handoffs.

- **agent-roster** (Pro): Every agent on the team: role, model, whether it's on, and two weeks of runs. Exports `AgentRoster`.
- **instructions-editor** (Pro): An agent's standing instructions, with variables like {{workspace.name}} that are filled in per run. Exports `InstructionsEditor`.
- **mcp-connect** (Pro): Consent to connect an MCP server: where it runs and who runs it, what it says it can do (its tools, by name and description), the permissions it asks for, and how to disconnect later. Exports `McpConnect`.
- **model-settings** (Pro): Which model an agent uses and how hard it thinks. Exports `ModelSettings`.
- **permission-mode** (Pro): The agent's permission mode, with what each mode lets it do written out, and a way to change it. Exports `PermissionMode`.
- **stop-all** (Pro): A workspace-wide stop: "Pause every agent". Exports `StopAll`.
- **tool-permissions** (Pro): What each tool an agent may call is allowed to do: always, ask first, or never. Exports `ToolPermissions`.

## App shell

The app around the agent: layout, sidebar, command menu, sessions, notices.

- **account-state** (Pro): A whole-page stop for a signed-in person the app can't show anything to yet: no account, removed from one, email not verified, an invite to accept. Exports `AccountState`.
- **app-layout** (Pro): The app frame: sidebar, main column, and an optional side panel the person can resize by dragging (or with the arrow keys on the divider). Exports `AppLayout`.
- **app-sidebar** (Pro): With `rail`, a toggle by the brand lets the person collapse the sidebar to a rail of icons on a wide screen, and expand it again. Exports `AppSidebar`.
- **artifact-panel** (Pro): A document or file to read beside the work, for a SidePanel tab or a full-width view. Exports `ArtifactPanel`.
- **command-palette** (Pro): Search or jump (⌘K): pages, threads, places and actions from one box, with the service's own results alongside. Exports `CommandPalette`, `CommandTrigger`, `matchEveryWord`.
- **environment-band** (Pro): A slim strip naming the account and the environment in scope, in the environment's own colour. Exports `EnvironmentBand`, `EnvironmentMark`, `environmentHue`.
- **inbox** (Pro): Every agent thread that has something for you, by what it needs: approvals and questions waiting on you first, then failures, then work that finished. Exports `Inbox`.
- **notification-center** (Pro): Everything that happened while you were away, behind a bell. Exports `NotificationCenter`.
- **page-header** (Pro): The top of every page that isn't a thread: where you are (breadcrumb), what the page is, what you can do here (actions), and its views (tabs). Exports `PageHeader`.
- **page-state** (Pro): What a page shows instead of its content: nothing here yet (empty), nothing matches the filters (no-match), something broke (error), it can't be shown to you (unavailable), or the service can't be reached from here (offline). Exports `PageState`, `PageSkeleton`, `ListStateView`.
- **service-notice** (Pro): A notice about the service itself, above the composer: a usage limit, a model that's down, a trial running out. Exports `ServiceNotice`.
- **session-expired** (Pro): The sign-in ran out while the app was open. Exports `SessionExpiredDialog`.
- **session-list** (Pro): Threads, newest first, grouped by day, with pinned threads on top. Exports `SessionList`.
- **settings-layout** (Pro): Settings: grouped sections down the side and the open one beside them. Exports `SettingsLayout`, `SettingsSection`.
- **shortcuts-dialog** (Pro): Every keyboard shortcut, grouped by where it works, printed for this platform (⌘ on a Mac, Ctrl elsewhere). Exports `ShortcutsDialog`.
- **side-panel** (Pro): The panel beside the thread: one tab per open item (a diff, an approval, a document), each closable. Exports `SidePanel`.
- **sound-setting** (Pro): The person's control for sound: "Sounds: Off / When I'm away / Always", the events as checkboxes with when each is raised and the visible cue it comes with (a sound is never the only signal), and a Play button for each that plays the brand's file or says no sound is set. Exports `SoundSetting`.
- **toast** (Pro): Short notices in the corner: polite for successes, assertive for errors, which stay until dismissed. Exports `Toaster`, `dismissToast`, `capToasts`, `toast`.

## Team

People and access: members, invites, roles.

- **access-request** (Pro): Ask for a role you don't have on an environment. Exports `AccessRequest`.
- **account-create** (Pro): Create your company's account. Exports `AccountCreate`.
- **audit-log** (Pro): The account's audit log. Exports `AuditLog`.
- **consent-ceremony** (Pro): Consent that names exactly what flows where: each flow as what → where → how long it's kept, an acknowledgement the person ticks themselves, and how to take it back. Exports `ConsentCeremony`.
- **invite-chooser** (Pro): Shown at sign-in when more than one account has invited you. Exports `InviteChooser`.
- **invite-members** (Pro): Invite people by pasting any list of emails. Exports `InviteMembers`.
- **members-table** (Pro): Members, their role on each environment, and invites still pending. Exports `MembersTable`.
- **profile-settings** (Pro): Who you are in the app: your name, your email (shown, but changed through your sign-in provider, which the field says), your time zone for schedules and timestamps, and your theme. Exports `ProfileSettings`.
- **setup-checklist** (Pro): What's left before the first useful answer: connect an environment, let the agents read it, invite the team. Exports `SetupChecklist`.
- **sign-in** (Pro): Sign in without a password: your company's SSO, the sign-in providers the app offers (`providers`), a passkey (`onPasskey`), or a one-time code sent to your email. Exports `SignIn`.
- **step-up-dialog** (Pro): A verification step before a sensitive action: the person proves it's them again, by a passkey, a fresh SSO sign-in, or a code, whichever the app provides (each shows only when its callback is given). Exports `StepUpDialog`.
- **step-walker** (Pro): A guided walk through stages: the stages across the top, the current one as a focus card below. Exports `StepWalker`.
- **terms-consent** (Pro): The AI disclosure and terms, asked once per terms version. Exports `TermsConsent`.

## Knowledge

What the agent knows: documents, diagrams, freshness.

- **confidence-mark** (Pro): How sure the system is, with what it rests on. Exports `ConfidenceMark`.
- **diagram** (Pro): A diagram an agent wrote as Mermaid (a data model, a flow, a sequence), rendered in strict mode in the theme's colours, or boxes and arrows given as data and laid out by Candor. Exports `Diagram`.
- **freshness-stamp** (Pro): How old a piece of knowledge is. Exports `FreshnessStamp`.
- **knowledge-sources** (Pro): Where the agents' knowledge comes from, grouped by door: the environment itself, sampled data, files and links people shared, answers they gave. Exports `KnowledgeSources`.
- **memory-manager** (Pro): What agents remember about this account, one line each, with who taught it and when. Exports `MemoryManager`.
- **memory-mode** (Pro): Whether agents use memory: on, paused or off, with what each does to the memories already kept. Exports `MemoryMode`.
- **memory-used** (Pro): The line under a reply that says what it remembered: "Used 2 memories", which opens them, each with who taught it and when. Exports `MemoryUsed`.
- **prose-diff** (Pro): An agent's rewrite of a document (a knowledge page, a process description), shown word by word against the original. Exports `ProseDiff`.
- **provenance-trace** (Pro): Which evidence each claim in an answer rests on, drawn as lines between the two while you look. Exports `ProvenanceTrace`.
- **raci-chip** (Pro): Who's responsible, accountable, consulted or informed, as a compact chip. Exports `RaciChips`.
- **retrieval-inspector** (Pro): The passages behind an answer, in the order the retriever ranked them. Exports `RetrievalInspector`.
- **source-ingest** (Pro): Add knowledge: drop files, paste a link, or paste text (meeting notes, a process description). Exports `SourceIngest`.
- **version-history** (Pro): Live, draft and past versions of something editable (an agent's settings, a knowledge page), newest first, with who changed it and why. Exports `VersionHistory`.

## Operations

Running agents: traces, usage, health.

- **run-estimate** (Pro): What a run is likely to take before it starts: cost, time and (when it makes them) API calls, as ranges with what they're based on. Exports `RunEstimate`.
- **run-log** (Pro): Every agent run, one line each, newest first: status, what it was, who ran it, where, when, how long and what it cost. Exports `RunLog`.
- **run-receipt** (Pro): What a run did and what it cost: steps, time, model and spend, with unmeasured values shown as not measured rather than zero. Exports `RunReceipt`.
- **run-scrubber** (Pro): A timeline for replaying a run: the app's `events`, a track with a tick at each event's real timestamp (spaced by the time between them, never evenly unless the times are), and a thumb the person drags or moves with the keyboard. Exports `RunScrubber`.
- **spend-breakdown** (Pro): AI spend over time, split by model, agent or feature. Exports `SpendBreakdown`.
- **trace-viewer** (Pro): One run as a timeline: each span (agent step, model call, tool, external call, a wait for a person) as a bar on a shared clock, nested under its parent. Exports `TraceViewer`.
- **usage-meters** (Pro): What's used against each limit: seats, an environment's daily API allowance, agent work. Exports `UsageMeters`.

## Evals

Judging agent output: scorecards, failure clusters, review queues.

- **eval-scorecard** (Pro): An eval run against its baseline: overall pass rate, then each criterion's rate, its change from the baseline, and a regression flag where it fell by more than the threshold. Exports `EvalScorecard`.
- **failure-clusters** (Pro): Failing runs grouped by what went wrong, largest first, each with its share of failures, how it moved since last period, and a few real examples. Exports `FailureClusters`.
- **quality-trend** (Pro): Scores over time (judge scores on live threads, by default), with what changed alongside: a model switch, an instructions edit, a new tool. Exports `QualityTrend`.
- **review-queue** (Pro): Grade real agent answers one at a time, from the keyboard: P pass, F fail, J/K next and previous. Exports `ReviewQueue`.

## Admin

Settings and controls: permissions, schedules, data controls.

- **api-keys** (Pro): The account's API keys: each one's name, the part of it that's safe to show, what it can do, when it was created and last used, and when it expires. Exports `ApiKeys`.
- **channel-setup** (Pro): Where agents can reach the team outside the app, one row per channel: its status, where it posts, and when an agent may post without asking. Exports `ChannelSetup`.
- **data-controls** (Pro): Control over the account's data: facts about how it's used (from the service), an export, deleting thread history, and deleting the account. Exports `DataControls`.
- **data-region** (Pro): Where the account's data lives and is processed, service by service. Exports `DataRegion`.
- **data-retention** (Pro): How long each kind of data is kept, and what happens after. Exports `DataRetention`.
- **device-sessions** (Pro): Everywhere you're signed in, with how each session signed in (browser, device code, or a token from the environment), where, and when it was last used. Exports `DeviceSessions`.
- **email-layout** (Pro): The shell every transactional email uses: brand, title, body, one next step, and why you got it, rendered to HTML that survives email clients. Exports `EmailLayout`, `EmailPreview`, `renderEmail`.
- **environment-connect** (Pro): Connect an environment: sign in with its provider (OAuth), or enter the credentials it needs, then test the connection and see what the test found. Exports `EnvironmentConnect`.
- **integration-connect** (Pro): Connect an outside service to the app: through the provider's own sign-in (OAuth) or with an API key, with the access it asks for in plain words, a connection test and what it found, and what the integration can and can't reach. Exports `IntegrationConnect`.
- **notification-preferences** (Pro): What reaches you, and where: one row per kind of event, one column per channel. Exports `NotificationPreferences`.
- **role-matrix** (Pro): What each role can do, as a matrix. Exports `RoleMatrix`.
- **schedule-editor** (Pro): Create or edit a recurring job: its name, how often it runs written out in words, the time zone it keeps, the next five runs worked out from that, the agent that runs it and the instruction it gets. Exports `ScheduleEditor`, `nextRuns`.
- **schedule-list** (Pro): Recurring agent jobs (a morning health check, a weekly hygiene report): when they run in plain words, when they run next, a strip of recent outcomes, and pause/resume. Exports `ScheduleList`.
- **sso-setup** (Pro): Single sign-on through the account's identity provider. Exports `SsoSetup`.
- **webhooks** (Pro): The endpoints the app sends events to: each one's address, the events it gets, whether it's on, and its recent deliveries with their outcome, HTTP status and time taken. Exports `Webhooks`.

## Billing

Plans, usage and invoices.

- **billing-details** (Pro): The details printed on invoices, as a form: billing email, the name and tax ID on invoices, and the postal address. Exports `BillingDetails`.
- **downgrade-impact** (Pro): What moving to a smaller plan takes away, before you confirm: the features you lose (and what happens to anything that used them), the new monthly total, and when it takes effect. Exports `DowngradeImpact`.
- **invoice-history** (Pro): The account's invoices: number, when each was issued, the period it covers, the amount in its own currency, its status (an open or overdue one says when it's due), and a download your app serves. Exports `InvoiceHistory`.
- **plan-picker** (Pro): Choose a plan and seats. Exports `PlanPicker`.
- **subscription-status** (Pro): Where the subscription stands: plan, seats paid against seats used, the card on file, and when it renews or ends. Exports `SubscriptionStatus`.

## Collaboration

Working alongside other people and agents.

- **assignee-picker** (Pro): Choose a person or an agent for a task. Exports `AssigneePicker`.
- **away-digest** (Pro): What happened since you were last here, in the order you'd act on it: waiting on you, failed, finished. Exports `AwayDigest`.
- **comment-thread** (Pro): A discussion anchored to one thing in the app (a plan step, a diff line, a form field, an output), between people and agents. Exports `CommentThread`.
- **escalation** (Pro): Hand a case off outside the app, by a page, an email or a ticket: the ways the app offers, with who each would reach right now; exactly what will be sent and to whom, shown before anything is sent; and, once sent, a record of what went, to whom, when, the other system's reference and whether anyone has acknowledged it. Exports `Escalation`.
- **handoff-card** (Pro): A run passed from one person to another while it's in flight: who from, who to, the run and where it is, the note, and what does and doesn't transfer. Exports `HandoffCard`.
- **presence** (Pro): Who is looking at the same thing right now, people and agents, from the presence data the app passes: a stack of avatars that opens a list of each one and what they're doing (viewing, editing, idle since a time). Exports `Presence`.
- **share-thread** (Pro): Share a thread: who can open it, and where the shared copy ends (so later messages aren't shared by accident). Exports `ShareThread`.

## Data

Tables and records.

- **attributes-rail** (Pro): A record's key/value facts as a definition list: label left, value right, hairline-separated. Exports `AttributesRail`.
- **column-mapper** (Pro): Match file columns to the object's fields. Exports `ColumnMapper`.
- **data-import** (Pro): Drop a spreadsheet, then see exactly what was read: rows, columns with sample values, and any rows that couldn't be read and why. Exports `DataImport`.
- **data-table** (Pro): Rows of records: search, sort, filter chips, column settings, selection and pages. Exports `DataTable`.
- **details-list** (Pro): Titled groups of label-and-value rows for a card a person reads and confirms: commands with a copy control, checks, services, risky paths, each group foldable. Exports `DetailsList`.
- **filter-bar** (Pro): Build filters one at a time: pick a field, a condition and a value (text, a number, one of the field's options, or a time window with presets like "Last 7 days"), then Add. Exports `FilterBar`, `useFilterChips`.
- **filter-chips** (Pro): Active filters as removable chips, with a clear-all. Exports `FilterChips`.
- **import-review** (Pro): Check rows before they land: how many are ready, which need fixing and why, grouped by kind of problem. Exports `ImportReview`.
- **reconcile-table** (Pro): Rows matched between two sources, side by side: the ones that agree, the ones in only one source, and the ones that conflict, with the fields that differ marked and both values shown. Exports `ReconcileTable`.
- **tree** (Pro): A hierarchy (objects → fields, a flow's elements, a knowledge base's sections) with the keyboard behaviour of a tree: ↑↓ move, → opens or steps in, ← closes or steps out, Home/End jump, Enter selects. Exports `Tree`.

## Charts

Charts with accessible colours.

- **bar-chart** (Pro): Columns by category, grouped or stacked. Exports `BarChart`.
- **bullet-bar** (Pro): Actual against a target in one row (coverage against the 75% production needs, adoption against a goal). Exports `BulletBar`.
- **chart-frame** (Pro): The frame every chart sits in: title, legend, a chart/table toggle, and the states a chart can be in. Exports `ChartFrame`, `ChartSizeProvider`, `useChartTip`.
- **donut-chart** (Pro): Parts of a whole. Exports `DonutChart`.
- **heatmap** (Pro): Intensity over a grid (field fill rate by object, runs by hour and day). Exports `Heatmap`.
- **line-chart** (Pro): Change over time. Exports `LineChart`.
- **sparkline** (Pro): A word-sized trend. Exports `Sparkline`.

## Reports

Readable summaries of work.

- **comparison-view** (Pro): Before and after, numerically: each measure's two values and the change, coloured by whether that change is good for it. Exports `ComparisonView`.
- **finding** (Pro): One finding with its evidence attached: severity as icon and word (never colour alone), what was found, the evidence it rests on, and what to do next when there's a clear step. Exports `Finding`.
- **insight-ledger** (Pro): The executive summary, in the three states it can honestly be in: not run yet; partial (some sections couldn't be computed, named); or ready, with counts by severity and the few findings that matter most. Exports `InsightLedger`.
- **report-sheet** (Pro): The paged chassis of a report (release readiness, configuration audit): a cover with what it covers and when its data was read, numbered sections, an export bar, and a provenance footer saying who or what generated it from which sources. Exports `ReportSheet`, `ReportSection`.
- **stat-card** (Pro): One metric: label, value, change against a named period, and a small trend. Exports `StatCard`, `KpiRow`.
- **subscore-card** (Pro): Weighted subscores behind an overall score. Exports `SubscoreCard`.

## Building blocks

Small pieces every screen uses: locked controls, status dots, step lists, relative times.

- **copy-field** (free): A value a person copies somewhere else (a callback URL, a scope list). Exports `CopyField`.
- **degraded-panel** (free): A degraded result: what went wrong, what is missing because of it, and a retry only when the caller can actually retry. Exports `DegradedPanel`.
- **graph-view** (Pro): A directed graph drawn from nodes that name what they come after, laid out on its own (layers, then an order that crosses few arrows; `lib/graph-layout`). Exports `GraphView`, `GraphViewSwitch`.
- **locale** (free): The interface's words, language and direction. Exports `LocaleProvider`, `directionOf`, `place`, `useLocale`, `useFormat`, `useHydrated`, `useStrings`, `useStartSide`, `useNouns`.
- **locked** (free): The honest-state rule: a control that cannot be used says why. Exports `Locked`.
- **relative-time** (free): A time as people say it ("5 minutes ago"), with the exact time on hover, safe to render on the server. Exports `RelativeTime`, `formatRelative`, `useNow`.
- **status-dot** (free): A small status mark. Exports `StatusDot`.
- **step-list** (free): A run's steps with their status, each mark drawn still on mount and animated only when the status changes on screen. Exports `StepList`, `StepMark`.
- **streaming-text** (free): Text that is still arriving. Exports `StreamingText`, `ShimmerLabel`.
- **surface** (free): Candor's card: a plain, muted, bordered or floating surface, so no screen hand-rolls its own. Exports `Surface`, `surfaceVariants`.
- **type-to-confirm** (Pro): A step that can't be undone, confirmed by typing a name: "Type prod-eu to confirm." The action stays locked, and says why, until the text matches exactly (spaces at either end don't count). Exports `TypeToConfirm`.

- **pagination** (Pro): Links between pages of a list, in Candor's theme: previous, next and numbered pages, with the current page marked `aria-current="page"` and a labelled navigation landmark. Exports `Pagination`, `PaginationContent`, `PaginationEllipsis`, `PaginationItem`, `PaginationLink`, `PaginationNext`, `PaginationPrevious`, `PaginationRange`, `pageWindow`.
- **password-input** (Pro): A password field with a button that shows or hides what was typed. Exports `PasswordInput`.
- **popover** (free): shadcn's popover (Radix) in Candor's theme. Exports `Popover`, `PopoverTrigger`, `PopoverContent`, `PopoverAnchor`, `PopoverHeader`, `PopoverTitle`, `PopoverDescription`.
- **progress** (free): A bar for work whose progress is measured: an upload, an import, an index. Exports `Progress`.
- **radio-group** (Pro): A set of choices where one can be picked. Exports `RadioGroup`, `RadioGroupItem`.
- **scroll-area** (Pro): shadcn's scroll area (Radix) in Candor's theme. Exports `ScrollArea`, `ScrollBar`.
- **select** (Pro): shadcn's select (Radix) in Candor's theme. Exports `Select`, `SelectContent`, `SelectGroup`, `SelectItem`, `SelectLabel`, `SelectScrollDownButton`, `SelectScrollUpButton`, `SelectSeparator`, `SelectTrigger`, `SelectValue`.
- **separator** (Pro): shadcn's separator (Radix) in Candor's theme. Exports `Separator`.
- **sheet** (Pro): shadcn's sheet (Radix dialog from an edge) in Candor's theme. Exports `Sheet`, `SheetTrigger`, `SheetClose`, `SheetContent`, `SheetHeader`, `SheetFooter`, `SheetTitle`, `SheetDescription`.
- **skeleton** (free): A loading placeholder in the shape of what's coming. Exports `Skeleton`.
- **slider** (free): A control for a value in a range, with one thumb or, when the value has two numbers, a range. Exports `Slider`.
- **stepper** (Pro): The steps of a process, with where the person is. Exports `Stepper`.
- **switch** (free): A setting that is on or off. Exports `Switch`.
- **table** (Pro): shadcn's table in Candor's theme: the plain table elements, for rows you lay out yourself. Exports `Table`, `TableHeader`, `TableBody`, `TableFooter`, `TableHead`, `TableRow`, `TableCell`, `TableCaption`, `TableEmpty`.
- **tabs** (Pro): shadcn's tabs (Radix) in Candor's theme. Exports `Tabs`, `TabsList`, `TabsTrigger`, `TabsContent`, `tabsListVariants`.
- **textarea** (Pro): shadcn's textarea in Candor's theme. Exports `Textarea`.
- **time-input** (Pro): A field for a time of day, "14:30". Exports `TimeInput`.
- **toggle-group** (Pro): A row of toggles in Candor's theme: one choice from a few (`type="single"`) or several at once (`type="multiple"`). Exports `ToggleGroup`, `ToggleGroupItem`.
- **toggle** (Pro): A two-state button in Candor's theme, for one setting that is on or off (bold, wrap lines, show hidden files). Exports `Toggle`, `toggleVariants`.
- **tooltip** (free): shadcn's tooltip (Radix) in Candor's theme. Exports `Tooltip`, `TooltipTrigger`, `TooltipContent`, `TooltipProvider`.

## Shared types and helpers

Types and pure functions the components share.

- **scale** (Pro): Chart scales and tick helpers shared by Candor's charts. Exports `niceTicks`, `linear`, `compact`, `formatValue`, `seriesColor`.
- **composer-sources** (Pro): A "Connected sources" section for Composer's @ menu, from your MCP connections. Exports `useComposerSources`.
- **change-hash** (Pro): The sha256 of a change, in the same canonical form in the browser and on the server, so an approval made against a hash can be checked where the change runs. Exports `changeHash`, `canonicalJson`.
- **chat** (free): The data a Candor thread renders.
- **data** (Pro): Data, chart and report shapes.
- **diff** (Pro): A token-level diff (longest common subsequence). Exports `tokenizeWords`, `diffTokens`.
- **fill-strings** (free): A message's forms chosen by a word: `vars[select]` when it names a case, else the `gender` of the noun called `select`, else `other`. Exports `startOf`, `fill`, `pick`, `singularNouns`, `englishStrings`, `withNouns`.
- **format-elapsed** (free): A measured span of time in the locale: "4.2s" under ten seconds, "42s" under a minute, then "2m 5s". Exports `formatElapsed`.
- **graph-layout** (Pro): Lays out a directed graph in layers, from the edges the data already has: each node names the nodes it comes after, and the layout works out where everything goes. Exports `layoutGraph`.
- **highlight** (free): A small syntax highlighter for code an agent shows: it splits text into typed tokens (keyword, string, comment…), and Payload renders each as a span. Exports `canHighlight`, `tokenize`.
- **know** (free): The data behind the agents' knowledge base and agent settings.
- **mcp-input** (free): MCP's "input required" results (spec 2026-07-28, multi round-trip requests) as Candor data: a server's form becomes questions for ClarifyingQuestions, a plain confirmation or a link to open becomes a two-answer Decision for ApprovalDecision, and the person's answers become the `inputResponses` the client sends when it retries the call. Exports `isMcpInputRequired`, `mcpInputView`, `mcpInputResponses`, `mcpRetryParams`.
- **motion** (free): Candor's motion layer: fourteen families, one per kind of change, each tunable by a brand file, and the hooks that decide when a change has settled or arrived; a theme tunes how a change looks, never when it happens. Exports `motionVariantIsFixed`, `motionVariantValue`, `motionMomentOf`, `motion`, `useSettled`, `useArrived`, `useLeaving`, `motionMode`, `useMotionMode`, `motionLevel`, `useMotionAllowed`.
- **ops** (Pro): Ops, billing and admin shapes. Exports `formatMoney`.
- **render-prop** (free): Lets Candor's Radix-based primitives also take Base UI's `render` prop. Exports `withRender`.
- **safe-markdown** (free): Reads model text as safe markdown: paragraphs, lists and fenced code. Exports `markdownBlocks`, `inline`, `plainBlocks`.
- **sound** (free): The names and the reading half of Candor's sound layer. Exports `soundString`, `readSoundVolume`, `readSoundToken`, `mayPlay`.
- **status** (free): The status vocabulary every Candor agent component shares. Exports `useStatusLabel`, `isTerminal`, `runLiveness`.
- **team** (Pro): The data behind the app shell and the team screens: an account has an owner and members; a member holds at most one role per environment; invites go to an email; audit events carry ids and codes, never names. Exports `environmentLabel`.
- **use-answering-approvals** (Pro): The guard every chat with permission prompts needs: while an answer is being sent, that request's buttons wait, so Allow can't be pressed twice; and an answer that fails to send leaves the prompt answerable again and says so, instead of an unhandled rejection. Exports `useAnsweringApprovals`.
- **use-arrivals** (Pro): Calls `onNew` with the ids that weren't there before: the way to raise a sound or a signal from data, never from a mount. Exports `useArrivals`.
- **use-attention** (Pro): Something waits on a person, or finished while they were away: a count (and a count per kind), a "(n) " badge on the document title, and, only where the app and the browser both allow it, a system notification or a sound. Exports `playSoundFile`, `playSoundEvent`, `useAttention`.
- **use-copy** (free): Copy text and report what actually happened. Exports `useCopy`.
- **use-keyboard-review** (Pro): Keyboard review for any list of rows a person keeps or drops: extracted fields, proposed edits, matched records, suggested tags. Exports `useKeyboardReview`.
- **use-shortcut** (free): Run `handler` when a key combo is pressed anywhere on the page: "mod+k", "mod+shift+o", "?", "escape". Exports `isApple`, `comboKeys`, `useShortcut`.
- **use-virtual-list** (free): Render only the items of a long list that are in or near view, for Thread's and SessionList's `virtualize`. Exports `useVirtualList`.
- **work** (Pro): The data behind agent work: plans, approvals, runs, diffs, logs and tests.
- **server** (Premium): What every full-stack block and template shares on the server: who is signed in (one getViewer seam for your auth), a check every changing route makes that refuses a request another site's page sent (crossSite), one database connection per server process, the Refusal a rule throws (said to the person as written, while any other error reaches the browser as a plain sentence with a reference and its detail stays in the server log), and the agent's runtime settings. Installed with any block or template; each keeps its own schema, store and migrations. Exports `DemoSignIn`, `setDatabase`, `database`, `demoViewer`, `setViewerSource`, `crossSite`, `crossSiteRefused`, `demoAuthAllowed`, `getViewer`, `viewerName`, `signedOut`, `demoSessionRoutes`, `errorText`, `errorResponse`, `guardTools`, `guardToolSet`, `approvalSigning`.

## Presets

Ready vocabularies for common systems, such as Salesforce.

- **github-kinds** (Pro): GitHub's repository objects, as entity kinds.
- **hubspot-kinds** (Pro): HubSpot's CRM and automation objects, as entity kinds.
- **jira-kinds** (Pro): Jira's work-tracking objects, as entity kinds.
- **linear-kinds** (Pro): Linear's objects, as entity kinds.
- **salesforce-kinds** (Pro): Salesforce's metadata and data, as entity kinds.

## Theme

Colours, type, radius and motion as CSS variables, in light, dark and high contrast.

- **tokens** (free): Candor's tokens without its colours: the --cd-* variables, Candor's own @theme entries and the motion utilities every item's classes assume. It sets nothing a shadcn project already defines (radius, sidebar, colour roles, type scale, base styles). Every item installs it. A Candor project imports styles/candor.css and needs nothing more; with plain shadcn and your own colours, import styles/candor-tokens.css once, after Tailwind.
- **theme** (free): Candor's default theme: light, dark and high contrast, contrast-checked. Import styles/candor.css after Tailwind.
- **font-inter** (free): Inter, Candor's default typeface, self-hosted (OFL-1.1). Optional: without it the theme uses the system font. Import styles/candor-font-inter.css next to candor.css.
- **font-source-sans** (free): Source Sans 3, self-hosted (OFL-1.1), as an alternative to Inter. Import styles/candor-font-source-sans.css after candor.css; it points --cd-font at it.
- **font-ibm-plex** (free): IBM Plex Sans, self-hosted (OFL-1.1), as an alternative to Inter. Import styles/candor-font-ibm-plex.css after candor.css; it points --cd-font at it.
- **sounds** (Pro): Five short starter sounds (CC0, from Kenney) for needs-you, finished, failed, reply and silent. Installs scripts/candor-sounds.mjs and public/sounds/LICENCE.txt; run node scripts/candor-sounds.mjs once to write the five MP3s to public/sounds/, then name them in your brand file.
- **theme-slate** (free): Slate, a gallery theme. Cool blue-grey neutrals and a blue accent; dark is a deep navy slate. Contrast-checked like the default. Import styles/candor-theme-slate.css after candor.css.
- **theme-paper** (free): Paper, a gallery theme. Warm off-white grounds, blue-black ink and a terracotta accent; dark is a warm sepia. Contrast-checked like the default. Import styles/candor-theme-paper.css after candor.css.
- **theme-console** (free): Console, a gallery theme. Dark-first and dense: near-black grounds, a green accent and the compact density. Light is a muted light console. Contrast-checked like the default. Import styles/candor-theme-console.css after candor.css.
- **theme-signal** (free): Signal, a gallery theme. True greys with no tint and one high-saturation indigo for the action that matters. Contrast-checked like the default. Import styles/candor-theme-signal.css after candor.css.
